caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock rendered in color and situated prominently within a rectangular frame. The clock is made of wood with a prominent brown woodgrain texture and rich, natural hues. Its structure is characterized by a rectangular base with a subtly molded plinth and small rounded feet. The central body features a single door with a small latch, and the wood pattern continues with visible grain. At the top, the clock widens slightly and is capped with an ornate, shaped pediment that features two symmetrical scrolls and a central finial. The face of the clock is round with Roman numerals marking the hours and decorative gold and white motifs above the dial, as well as additional embellishments in the corners. The hands of the clock are black, and the dial includes a minute ring with smaller markings. To the upper left of the main composition, there is a faint, monochromatic technical drawing or diagram of the clock in profile, showing dimensions and internal structural details without color or shading. The overall background of the drawing is a pale, unadorned beige surface, with a thin black border outlining the main image area.
title: Grandfather's Clock (Timepiece)
